description: Grove 8x8 RGB LED Matrix — named patterns, emoji, hex bitmaps, color control

matrix.set_pattern.description: Display a pattern on the matrix

pattern.description: Named pattern (smile, heart, check, x, all_on, border, diamond, exclaim, question, up, down, left, right, ...) or 16-char hex bitmap

color.description: RGB hex color e.g. FF0000. Ignored for emoji patterns.
